usedFor: Railway.app deploys applications, and “Deploy Service” and “Roll Back Deployment” move a service to a new or earlier version.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Service” in Railway.app
bestTemplate.why: A message can start a new service from a GitHub repo or Docker image.

watchOut: “Delete All Project Services” removes every service in a project, so keep it out of unchecked steps.
